text: Build step 2 of the build order in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12: retry-from-record (section 3.5). Today, after a rejected or failed job, the user writes the retry request by hand, folding in the verifier's findings and the cause; today's examples include 69gf, t1y6, 3p3y and jk8v. Instead, a retry of a rejected or failed job starts from its introspection record: the proposed next request, cause and prevention, plus the original scope and accepted corrections that retries already carry. Give the user one short command to accept it, such as 'athena retry <job>', which shows the reading as 'ask' does. Earlier cases of the same class should be visible to the reader of the retry, so a fourth repeat is seen as a repeat. Verify with fixture records in a temporary directory.
